description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent that runs autonomously in an isolated session and reports back later.

subagent_type.description: Subagent type to run. Must be one of the names listed in the current system prompt's `<available_subagents>` section.

prompt.description: Complete, self-contained instructions for a new task, or updated direction and context for a continued task. Include the objective, relevant scope, constraints, expected deliverable, output format, and verification instructions when applicable.

max_turns.description: Positive integer interaction-turn budget for this invocation. Defaults to the current subagent policy when omitted. An unfinished child is reminded to return a phase report when the budget is reached; use a smaller value when early path verification or frequent parent-child interaction is needed.

thread_id.description: Identifier of a previously accepted subagent thread to continue, using the `thread_id` returned by an earlier task receipt or completion message.
